_comment: Per-route admission control for the N-team trade analyze routes (review R2-5, owner directive 2026-10-20 §13 'bounded resources' / 'cancellation/timeout'). Read ONLY by src/api/compute_admission.py. maxConcurrent bounds how many engine COMPUTATIONS (not joined single-flight waiters) may run at once on that route in one process; a request arriving when every slot is busy is refused at once with a retryable 503 instead of queueing behind the GIL. timeoutSeconds bounds how long one caller waits for its computation; the computation itself cannot be interrupted (it runs in a worker thread), so it keeps its slot until it really finishes, and an identical retry joins it rather than starting another. BOTH SIZES ARE OWNER-CONFIRMED (owner decision 6, 2026-11-01: keep public 2 / 5 s and private 2 / 30 s, values unchanged; previously PENDING OWNER CONFIRMATION under directive §16 gate 7). They were conservative defaults chosen against the Lane E-4 local measurement (public worst-case 4-team p50 55-61 ms / p99 <= 623 ms under in-process contention; private worst-case 4-team p50 200-330 ms; one process saturates at ~12-14 public analyses/s because the work is GIL-bound), not fitted constants. A missing or malformed entry falls back to the defaults in compute_admission.DEFAULTS; a non-positive value is never 'unlimited'. The trade_title_odds entry (added later, PR #2312) is NOT covered by the OWNER_CONFIRMED status: it carries its own PENDING_OWNER_CONFIRMATION label.

trade_title_odds._comment: POST /api/trade/title-odds (DYN10 #4, PR #2312; owner-held flag trade_title_odds_lens, default OFF). A PENDING OWNER-CONFIRMABLE DEFAULT, neither owner-confirmed nor fitted: the top-level OWNER_CONFIRMED status covers the two analyze routes above only. maxConcurrent bounds how many season simulations (each ~5.5 s of GIL-bound work on the lens's 12-team fixture, plus ~1.4 s per extra changed roster) run at once in one process; a request for a further DISTINCT trade answers state unavailable / title_odds_busy (retryable) instead of starting another. An identical request from the same user joins the running computation and takes no slot. timeoutSeconds bounds how long one caller waits (below nginx's 120 s /api/ read timeout and the War Room panel's 60 s request ceiling); past it the caller gets title_odds_timeout while the computation keeps its slot until it really finishes, and its result is cached for that user's retry.
